tuition_review.notes.2: The program directs applicants to its exact Illinois calculator selection and changes new MCS entrants to self-supporting status in Fall 2027. The captured calculator offers start terms only through Summer 2027; no applicable Fall 2027 entrant rate was returned. Do not substitute Chicago, online or pre-change funding/rates.
